# 1.37.0-beta.8

Eighth beta of 1.37.0: final polish and fixes.

## Auto model

- Auto now has a third model for replies that need no thinking at all: greetings, the date, a simple sum, or opening a program. It is the new "Fast tasks" row under Chat answers in Settings, Models.
- Anything that asks to learn, explain or solve something stays on the light model or above.
- Scientific, research and analytical questions, proofs, debugging and other answers where accuracy matters now go to the heavy model much more often.

## Agent

- "Do it quickly" in your first message now starts the fast agent, just as it already did when you wrote it while the agent was working.
- The agent now knows when to search the web, when to read a page, when to use its own browser and when to work in program windows. Showing you a page opens it in your own browser.
- When the agent browser is off, the chat and the agent say so and point to the switch on the Security page instead of promising a browser.
- A browser engine error no longer stops the whole agent run: the agent reads the page again or finishes without the browser and says what did not work.
- The agent no longer goes round in circles in its browser. It used to forget every page except the last one it read, even pages it opened in one step and had not looked at yet, so it kept reopening a list and the items from it. Earlier pages now stay in its memory in short form, with their text and links, and opening the same page again and again gets a reminder.
- Reading a page by its address now opens that page instead of rereading the current one.
- The agent now sees each option and field on a page by its label, and no longer sees controls hidden from you. On a quiz it used to tick a hidden "clear my choice" option instead of the answer, believe the question was answered and go back and forth between the question and the summary.
- A choice made on a page is now saved with the page's own button instead of being lost by opening another address, and a step that did not work twice is no longer repeated the same way: the agent checks a screenshot, tries another way or finishes the rest of the task.
- In the agent's block, each result now sits under its own action. After the agent was switched to another model, results used to shift by one, so a page appeared under the wrong address.
- Asking an agent to hurry when it already runs on the fast model no longer restarts it from the beginning: it gets the request and carries on.

## New default models

These replace the models for everyone once, as with earlier default updates. OpenRouter comes first; without an OpenRouter key the models move to the provider of your key.

- Chat: Fast tasks MiniMax M3.1 Flash (Nitro, medium), Light tasks Claude Haiku 5.5 (medium), Heavy tasks Claude Sonnet 5.5 (medium), Router Jev 1.14.
- Agent: Fast tasks MiniMax M3.1 Flash (Nitro, medium), Light tasks Claude Haiku 5.5 (medium), Heavy tasks Claude Sonnet 5.5 (high).
- Service tasks: chat titles DeepSeek V4 Flash (no reasoning), chat summary Claude Haiku 5.5 (low), Rosa Claude Haiku 5.5 (no reasoning).
- Bypass: Grok 4.3, or Abliterated Large Flash on Venice.
- Voice: recognition Gemini 3.5 Transcribe, or ElevenLabs Scribe v2 on Venice; reading aloud ElevenLabs Eleven v4 with the voice Roger at normal speed, or the Windows voice without an OpenRouter key.
- Your SynGuard switch and web search choice are kept.
